title: A Fatherless Child - Ensemble Roster
content: Protagonists: Ayanna Jackson (25, Social Worker, raised by single mom Leila Jackson, father absent) & Malachi Davis (27, Community Organizer/Youth Mentor, raised by Nia Davis, father absent). Supporting: Leila Jackson, Nia Davis, Tanesha Lee (Ayanna best friend), Tyler Brown (Malachi friend). Setting: Urban development community, all Black American cast.

title: A Fatherless Child - Thematic Engine
content: Explores the emotional, psychological, and generational impacts of absent fathers across an urban community, following Ayanna and Malachi as they break generational cycles and restore family identity.
